    val.criterion Options

    Source: R/options.R
    options.Rd

    Internally used, package-specific options. All options will prioritize R options() values, and fall back to environment variables if undefined. If neither the option nor the environment variable is set, a default value is used.

    Checking Option Values

    Option values specific to val.criterion can be accessed by passing the package name to env.

    options::opts(env = "val.criterion")

options::opt(x, default, env = "val.criterion")

    Options

    repos
    Metrics repositories to use implicitly for package filters. Will be accessed using available.packages(), so repository paths should follow similar conventions.
    default: 
    character(0L)
    option:

    val.criterion.repos

    envvar:

    R_VAL_CRITERION_REPOS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

    exceptions
    Packages that should be treated as exceptions. Even if they would otherwise be filtered out using preset filters, they would still be discoverable and installable without issue.
    default: 
    character(0L)
    option:

    val.criterion.exceptions

    envvar:

    R_VAL_CRITERION_EXCEPTIONS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

    quiet
    Wether filtering operations should be reported as they're being queried. Passed to the quiet parameter of individual functions where it's used.
    default: 
    FALSE
    option:

    val.criterion.quiet

    envvar:

    R_VAL_CRITERION_QUIET (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

    actions
    A set of calls that should prompt actions. See default_actions for an example of the expected format.
    default: 
    default_actions()
    option:

    val.criterion.actions

    envvar:

    R_VAL_CRITERION_ACTIONS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

    See also

    options getOption Sys.setenv Sys.getenv
